rows.model: New: spread, k=1.15, no EPA in price

findings: The x0.85/x0.80 shrink was the biggest error: it priced favourites too cheap, so the model kept 'finding' underdog value that lost (-8c per bet in 2026).
Adding EPA on top of the line made every season worse. The line already knows it. EPA stays on screen as a check, not in the price.
The 'favourites 80%+ only won 66.7%' result was 12 games. Over 1,359 games, 80%+ favourites won 86.9% vs 85.2% predicted.
Pregame injuries were double counted: the line moves on QB news. Now only fresh news the line hasn't moved for (<2 pts) is added.
The free model matches the sportsbook; it doesn't beat it. Real edges come from Kalshi lagging the sportsbook line and from late news — that's what Value/Wait now flags.

signalsStudy.finding: None of 32 situations beat the closing line in both samples. Rest, byes, travel, division games, prime time, weather, blowouts and big favourites are already priced. Altitude, cold, dome/open-air splits, Thursday/Thanksgiving short weeks and byes (incl. playoffs) are in the list too, all priced. Closest: a team starting a backup QB did ~0.7 pts worse than its line in both samples, too small and too noisy to price (≈2¢).

profilesStudy.finding: None of 25 pre-game matchup grades or 8 in-game grades beat the line / live price in both samples. Comebacks, 2nd-half fades, scoring by quarter, pass/run matchups, trenches, form, 3rd down, red zone, explosives, kicker and 4th-down habits are already in the price. Shown as context only. Teams that were outplaying the leader but trailing won +4.8¢ vs the live price (n=105, 2026: -14.0¢) — not enough to act on.
